check_quota.description: Check how many name lookups are left on this Agify plan before they start failing, and when the allowance resets. Put it in front of a large enrichment run to hold the run back rather than watch it fail halfway. Running out is reported as an answer, not an error, so a workflow can branch on it. Checking spends one lookup, because Agify only reports the allowance alongside a real answer.

estimate_age.description: Estimate how old someone is from their name. Send the fullest name you have - Agify reads the given name out of a full name itself, handles titles, initials and nicknames, and does not care what order the parts are in. Scope it to a country when you know one, since the same name skews older in some places than others. Every answer says how many records it rests on, and says plainly when there were none.

estimate_ages.description: Estimate an age for every name in a list, in one step - for enriching a set of contacts, a sign-up export or the results of an earlier step. The answers come back in the order the names went in, one for each, so they line up with the list they came from, and a summary gives the average, the youngest and the oldest without a second pass. Repeated names are only looked up once, because Agify charges by the name.

description: Estimate how old someone is likely to be from their name, using Agify's dataset of real-world name records. Enrich one contact or a whole list in a single step, and scope an estimate to a country when you know one, since the same name skews older in some places than others. Every answer says how many records it rests on and says plainly when there were none, so a workflow can tell a well-evidenced estimate from a guess. The free plan covers 2,500 names a month.
